item.title: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
item.description:
Title: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
Genre: Casual , Simulation
Developer: Kairosoft Co.,Ltd
Publisher: Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.
Release Date: Oct 22, 2026




About This Game

ONE PIECE comes to life as a restaurant management sim game!

As a new staff member, work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to turn the second location of the renowned Baratie floating restaurant into the greatest restaurant of the seas!

Get inspired by characters' ideas, choose your ingredients, and work with Sanji to cook delicious dishes. Arrange them into unique meal sets by adding different flourishes, then adventure to find even more recipes! From iconic series favorites like Water-Water Meat BBQ and Sea King Penne Gorgonzola to special creations that harness the powers of Devil Fruits, a treasure trove of dishes awaits.

Choose from over 200 furniture, building, and decorative items to make your restaurant uniquely yours! From dessert-themed Whole Cake Island pieces to futuristic Egghead items, the customization options are as vast as the sea. If a character likes your design, they may even become a regular!

From the Straw Hat Crew and beyond, over 400 ONE PIECE characters appear as staff and customers in a spritely pixel style for the first time in a game! With so many characters, you'll experience character events and special character interactions that can’t be found anywhere else.

item.title: Every Day We Fight
item.description:
Title: Every Day We Fight
Genre: Action , RPG , Strategy
Developer: Signal Space Lab
Publisher: Wild Hog Games
Release Date: Oct 22, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jul 10, 2025




About This Game

A mysterious alien invasion threatens humanity – time has come to a stop for all but your small band of freedom fighters. Caught in a seemingly endless loop, you must shape these ordinary civilians into heroes. Countless lives hang in the balance: you are humanity’s only hope to thwart the invaders.

With every new time loop, newly acquired experience and skills remain. As you explore the multiple districts of your wartorn city, anything you discover in one loop is available to you from the start of the next. Welcome to the resistance!

CONTROL IS IN YOUR HANDS

Your tactical prowess will be put to the test when the bullets start to fly – armed and positioned appropriately, allies can work closely together to assist one another, interrupt enemy movements, and bring about a quick end to challenging circumstances.

  • Take direct control of every shot as you aim down the sights, find where your target is weakest, and unleash a hail of bullets. Hit chances are determined entirely by your positioning, your aim, and your reaction time, with ballistics taking firing angles and obstructions into account.

  • Your resistance fighters can react to both friend and foe across turns on either side. Every individual has access to unique reflex actions to intercept enemy movement and assist allied kills, or to scramble away from enemy fire. Will you reserve your reflexes for defensive maneuvers when things take a turn for the worse, or will you use them to apply constant pressure on the enemy?

YOUR CHOICES MATTER

  • 12 unique guns, dozens of skills to unlock, and over 100+ different gun attachments & parts (including some with legendary perks). Discover interesting combinations and tailor each character’s loadout to your tactical needs.

  • In war, sacrifices must be made. Will you attempt to save other civilians at the risk of losing your progress? Or will you sacrifice the lives of those frozen in time in the interest of advancing your ultimate goal?

  • Your strategies can make or break an encounter. Sneak around the battlefield to obtain an optimal position, seek out opportunities to use the world around you, or go in guns blazing: every fight is different.

  • Multiple difficulty modes make the game as accessible - or difficult - as you would like. Including Iron Man mode and Forever War mode for those who truly want a challenge.

END THE FOREVER WAR

Take on a variety of mission types to thwart the alien invaders – shut down their harvesters, defuse their bombs, and take out their occupying troops to gain the skills you need and secure victory.

To break their hold, however, you must ultimately defeat the Rifter leaders. Hard to kill, heavily armored, and dangerously armed, these leaders hold the key to this war – every time one falls, the time loop shifts forward, bringing the Forever War closer to an end.

Your resistance grows stronger with each success, and with each failure – after all, for you, death is only the beginning.

We think you'll love Every Day We Fight if you enjoy…

XCOM® 2, STAR WARS Zero Company™, MENACE, Jagged Alliance 3, Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus, Wartales, Phoenix Point, Warhounds, Cyber Knights: Flashpoint

item.title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
item.description:
Title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
Genre: RPG
Developer: Square Enix , LANCARSE Ltd.
Publisher: Square Enix
Franchise: Final Fantasy
Release Date: Oct 22, 2026




About This Game

Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

◆ Cinematic pixel art

What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.

◆ A return to the familiar

A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.

◆ Strategic turn-based battles

Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.

◆ FINAL FANTASY legends

Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.

◆ Hours of side content to discover

The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.

item.title: Groundwork Simulator
item.description:
Title: Groundwork Simulator
Genre: Simulation , Early Access
Developer: XYZ STUDIO
Publisher: XYZ STUDIO
Release Date: Oct 22, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Oct 22, 2026




About This Game

WELCOME TO GROUNDWORK SIMULATOR

Groundwork Simulator puts you behind the controls of heavy machinery, with a landscape to reshape and gold to uncover. Dig into the hillside, haul material across your site and set up the equipment that turns a bucket of dirt into your next gold recovery. Work at your own pace or share the job with friends.

EVERY BUCKET CHANGES THE LANDSCAPE

Dig trenches, cut into hillsides and build up piles as you shape your worksite. Every scoop changes the ground you work on, creating new routes, steeper slopes and fresh challenges. Plan your approach, the ground you leave behind becomes the foundation for your next job.

REALISTIC PHYSICS

Dig with a realistic excavation engine and simulated hydraulic feedback that brings resistance to every scoop. Feel your machine respond as the bucket meets the ground and material builds up inside it. Adjust your angle and work with the available hydraulic power to cut through the terrain, fill your bucket and lift the load.

FROM DIRT TO GOLD

Explore the land in search of gold-rich ground. Drill and test for deposits, choose your digging spot and set up your wash plant. Excavate promising material, wash it through the sluice boxes and process the concentrate on the shaking table, from your first test hole to your next gold recovery.

WORK SOLO OR SHARE THE SITE

Run the operation yourself or divide the work in online co-op. Take the excavator while a friend handles transport, or keep material moving together between the digging area and the wash plant. Coordinate your machines and turn a patch of untouched ground into a busy worksite.

WATER SYSTEM

Bring water to your washing operation with pumps and hoses. Position your equipment, route your connections across the site and get water flowing where it’s needed. As your worksite grows, adapt your setup to keep the washing operation supplied.

TRANSPORT

Load your heavy machinery onto a trailer and haul it by truck to your next worksite. Line up for loading, plan your route and navigate tight turns, slopes and rough terrain with a heavy load behind you. Unload your equipment where you need it and get to work.

FIGHT THE TERRAIN

Mud, slopes and rough ground make every route a decision. Watch your traction, choose your approach and take care with a heavy load. Sometimes the next job is improving the ground beneath your wheels before you can get back to digging.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI tools were used to assist with some assets.



System Requirements

Windows

MacOS

item.title: Moadra
item.description:
Title: Moadra
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: Gloomsoft
Publisher: Gloomsoft
Release Date: Oct 22, 2026




About This Game

Traverse a massive interconnected world on the sand-swept planet of Protea VI. Unveil the grim mysteries of Protea VI at your own pace as Moadra. Endure challenging combat and evolve Moadra's abilities, solve puzzles, and reveal countless hidden paths and secrets throughout your mission to uncover your lost Neera heritage.

Whether you are trying to endure the desolate surface, ascend the deadly, freezing summits, or scout the research facility infested with malicious alien species, Protea VI has many lost secrets to uncover after your ancestors' extinction 20,000 years ago. Dangers await around every corner.

Use Moadra’s agility to your advantage to roll, dodge, leap, wall jump, and sprint at never-before-seen speeds to evade deadly organisms and hazardous elements. Use your swift reflexes, an arsenal of weapons, and special abilities to survive everything from low-level threats to gargantuan monsters that force you to use every tool at your disposal.

Activate your scanner bot and use X-ray vision to examine creatures and your surroundings more closely. Reveal hidden paths and secret areas invisible to the naked eye, and map out the places you explored.

Blow up unfriendly creatures and organisms to absorb their Protoplasm, lumps of energy-packed biomass. Consume it inside organic chambers to apply metamorphosis, and evolve your abilities and weapons to new levels.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Moadra contains frequent violence and gore.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Quad-Core Processor
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 900 series or similar
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 9 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or similar
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 4GB or similar
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 9 GB available space
